description:
A Flutter LLM Chat Client. Support Android & iOS & Harmony Next.

A Flutter LLM Chat Client. Support Android & iOS & Harmony Next.
✨ Features
- 🎨 Modern Design - Material You design language with dynamic color theming support (Android 12+).
- 🌙 Dark Mode - Perfectly adapted dark theme to protect your eyes.
- 🌍 Multi-language Support - Supports both English and Chinese interfaces.
- 🖥️ Multi-platform Support - Mobile (Android/iOS/Harmony) and Desktop (Windows/macOS/Linux).
- 🔄 Multi-provider Support - Supports major AI providers like OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic, etc.
- 🤖 Custom Assistants - Create and manage personalized AI assistants.
- 🖼️ Multimodal Input - Supports various formats including images, text documents, PDFs, Word documents, etc.
- 📝 Markdown Rendering - Full support for code highlighting, LaTeX formulas, tables, and more.
- 🎙️ Voice/TTS Providers - Built-in system TTS plus OpenAI / Google Gemini / ElevenLabs voice servers.
- 🛠️ MCP Support - Model Context Protocol tool integration.
- 🧰 Built-in MCP Tools - Includes a built-in MCP Fetch tool.
- 🔍 Web Search - Integrated with multiple search engines (Exa, Tavily, Zhipu, LinkUp, Brave, Bing, Metaso, SearXNG, Ollama, Jina, Perplexity, Bocha).
- 🧩 Prompt Variables - Supports dynamic variables like model name, time, etc.
- 📤 QR Code Sharing - Export and import provider configurations via QR codes.
- 💾 Data Backup - Supports chat history backup and restoration.
- 🌐 Custom Requests - Supports custom HTTP request headers and bodies.
- 🔡 Custom Fonts - Bring your own fonts (system fonts / Google Fonts).
- ⚙️ Android Background Generation - Keep chat generation running in the background (optional setting).
What's Changed
- feat: Add a desktop side panel that keeps files, topics, and browser tabs together for each conversation, with shortcuts.
- feat: Adapt desktop layouts down to a 360px-wide window.
- feat: Add isolated workspace web apps. A .app.html file keeps its own saved data and cookies, separate from normal browsing.
- feat: Bound how many images stay in context. Older tool screenshots can be omitted automatically, pinned images stay, and an omitted image can be attached again.
- feat: Quote selected message text into the composer, jump back to the source, and translate the selection in the app.
- feat: Copy an assistant in full, or choose memories, phrases, world books, skills, tools, and the default workspace.
- feat: Let each conversation choose its own MCP servers, or keep following the assistant.
- feat: Show the request URL while editing a provider, fill in a missing API version, and explain a failed connection test.
- feat: Remember which models from an OAuth account are enabled across syncs and sign-ins.
- feat: Encrypt new backups with Argon2id, and remember the encryption setting. Existing encrypted backups still restore.
- feat: Add ElevenLabs and Qwen speech transcription, including real-time, recorded audio, and Qwen Token Plan.
- feat: Add an optional legacy inline code style, with a lighter background, a thin border, and more line spacing.
- fix: Keep Gemini thought signatures with the provider that created them. Switching provider or model during a tool call starts a new reply instead of continuing the old round.
- fix: Continue from a context summary in a new chat without bringing back the messages that summary replaced.
- fix: Keep forked messages in their original order.
- fix: Keep a workspace file path on the message that produced it.
- fix: Match OAuth limits and usage with current Codex, Claude, Kimi, and Grok accounts, and show where sign-in failed.
- fix: Keep chats when storage is full, and recover from a local copy instead of opening an empty list.
- fix: Keep Android file saves when the activity is recreated.
- fix: Keep attachments intact while a backup is written, and keep the open chat visible when switching conversations.
- fix: Speed up long conversations with many tool calls, and keep their place while they update.
- fix: Render Mermaid diagrams in the system web view, stop block formulas from clipping, and keep Markdown tables and text readable on custom backgrounds.
- fix: Fix the in-app browser on iOS, macOS, and Windows, including toolbar insets, in-page search, clicks, and shutdown.
- fix: Read current memory in the iOS sandbox, and keep Node fetch working.
- fix: Accept MCP sign-in when OAuth discovery is nonstandard or the issuer URL has a trailing slash.
- fix: When a search provider reads full pages, point users to turn off the built-in page fetch so the tools don't overlap.
- fix: Keep IntelligentUI cards steady while they stream, and fix chart spacing.
- fix: Publish Linux builds with and without Impeller.
- fix: Fix several other known bugs and UI issues.
Full Changelog: https://github.com/Chevey339/kelivo/compare/v1.3.2...v1.3.3
